_comment: ZOO: the BYOK model catalog for the Muapi.ai gateway (server/app/zoo.py).
Converted mechanically from the upstream Open-Higgsfield-AI registry
Every endpoint is a real Muapi path under https://api.muapi.ai/api/v1/.
Add models by appending entries in the same shape - no code change.
Kind image = still picture; kind video = clip. mode = what goes in (t2i/i2i/t2v/i2v).
v0.463.1: +22 kie.ai entries (gateway: 'kie', endpoints = kie createTask model names from
Open-Higgsfield-AI data/models.json). Param names differ per model - image_field/images_param/
resolution_field/audio_field carry the real ones. Local refs upload to kie's CDN first.

v0.463.2 (2026-11-03): the FULL kie.ai catalog appended - 229 live models from GET api.kie.ai/api/v1/models (owner key, probe-verified), deduped against the 22 curated kie entries, Chat taskType excluded (media gateway, not an LLM chat endpoint). Param fields (aspects / durations / resolutions / image-audio-video fields / has_prompt) parsed mechanically from each model's OpenAPI spec at docs.kie.ai/market/**.md - 160 of the non-chat models have parsed specs; the rest ride minimal entries (endpoint + mode from taskType only). Video-to-video / video-editing models use mode v2v (reference video goes through extra, per-entry video_field). Speech / music / audio models are kind audio (t2s / t2m / a2a). Add more models by appending entries.
